text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
(—In this race, I will overcome the 
'Crimson Wedge'—)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
(For there is no trial... that a Saint 
cannot overcome—!)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaahーー!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a gallop that betrayed not the 
slightest hint of the misfortune weighing 
upon her.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Across the line!!! Red Desire takes first 
place!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: At that moment, I definitely heard it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The sound of the Saint shattering 
merciless fate—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Haa...! Haa...! Haa...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
—...I felt it. Just now, destiny 
undeniably shifted—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Having overcome the ultimate trial, Iâ

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I've completely overcome the fate of 
ruin—...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"With this body, I shall continue to 
gallop along this path of trials――!"

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: "Desire!! Our Saint, Red Desire!!!"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ――……Are you kidding me……?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
No way she's just recovered from an 
illness like that, right...? If anything, 
she's totally fired up...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Therefore, you have nothing to 
worry about.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: After all, I am a Saint.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
There is no issue. The flow of mana is as 
calm as a tranquil sea.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"The 'Crimson Wedge'... is currently 
sleeping quietly deep within me."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Through this ceremony, my soul has surely 
sublimated to even greater heights.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She is beginning to reach completion. As a 
saint. —As a single living being.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Congratulations, Desire-san.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
You have steadily learned to tame the 
shadows lurking within yourself.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: In that case, I—...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...Indeed. Transcending destiny, she has 
arrived at a new frontier..."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Carving out destiny with one's own body.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Beyond this point lies uncharted 
territory.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Your choice will surely bring about... a 
profound impact upon this world.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Telling me to proceed with caution and 
care.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Did your "friend" do that as well?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Yes... My "friend" also sends their 
blessings to your indomitable spirit.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"We will always watch over you. Until you 
reach that promised land..."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Cafe. To you, and to your wonderful 
friend.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
And... from the bottom of my heart, my 
deepest gratitude to all of my friends in 
this sanctuary—...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
...Through this race, I was able to calm 
the 'Crimson Wedge.'

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was as clear as day that Red Desire's 
condition had dramatically improved.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Now that I have tamed the 'Crimson Wedge' 
and overcome countless trials alongside 
you—"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"My soul has been elevated to heights 
never reached before."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
“And I pray once more. More strongly, more 
earnestly than before—”

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
With this body and these legs, I want to 
take on the world.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Guided by your own "desire," you wish to 
aim for an alternate world—!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"For that reason, aiming for the 'BC' is 
our top priority. ...However, we are still 
one step short."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
To cross the sea and challenge the world, 
I wish to obtain one more special 
radiance.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
That race from last year, run alongside 
her, which kept me anchored in this 
world...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Well, for someone like you, I've got some 
good news, you know?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Next year, why don't you go on an 
adventure into the wide world with me!?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Standing with a hand on the new door to 
"taking on the world"—that special 
someone...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Having overcome my destiny, I am now 
capable of delivering my absolute best 
run.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
To me, I want to secure a definitive 
victory in a race tied to my destiny... 
and cross the sea with my head held high.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
It shall become the breath of wind that 
propels the vessel of myself toward the 
'other world.'
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's head for the Japan Cup!
Yeah, let's head to the Japan Cup!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I can feel it close by. "That place" 
where the Saint, Red Desire, shall arrive.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Let us go. Toward the "Final Trial"—!
